data.title: How Israel Air Force air controllers managed crowded airspace during Iran strikes | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: It was the most complex, dangerous, and historic day since the establishment of the Israeli Air Force's air traffic control. Hundreds of aircraft of every possible type were returning simultaneously.
